claims: The Elmet Group is a U.S.-based advanced manufacturing company.
The Elmet Group specializes in high-performance refractory metals (tungsten, molybdenum).
The Elmet Group specializes in high-power microwave systems for defense, aerospace, and medical sectors.
The Elmet Group is the largest U.S.-owned producer of its type.
The Elmet Group has over 550 employees.
The Elmet Group comprises Elmet Technologies (materials/metals) and Microwave Techniques (high-power RF/microwave components).
The Elmet Group is a vertically integrated manufacturer.
The Elmet Group processes raw powder into finished products like wire, sheet, plate, and machined components.
The Elmet Group serves the aerospace industry.
The Elmet Group serves the defense industry including the US Navy.
The Elmet Group serves the semiconductor industry.
The Elmet Group serves the medical industry (diagnostic imaging).
The Elmet Group serves the energy industries.
The Elmet Group originated from a Philips Lighting plant founded in 1929.
Anania & Associates acquired The Elmet Group in 2015.
The Elmet Group acquired competitor H.C. Starck Solutions Americas in 2023.
The Elmet Group announced its IPO in April 2026.
The Elmet Group's IPO offers approximately 7.7 million shares.
The Elmet Group has key manufacturing sites in Lewiston, ME; Coldwater, MI; and Euclid, OH.
The Elmet Group supplies high-density tungsten materials for projects like the NASA Artemis lunar missions.
